title: Pear and Tuscan Soup
description: A hearty and comforting soup perfect for a cozy evening. This Tuscan-style soup is made with a variety of vegetables and finished with a hint of sweetness from the pear.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped kale and cook until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Add the diced pear and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Stir in the grated Parmesan cheese and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional Parmesan cheese if desired.
